raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
- `DeepseekV4AttnBackend.glue_draft_metadata` refuses the draft metadata glue graph when the backend needs host sequence lengths, as `glue_target_verify_metadata` already does. Under DSpark `needs_cpu_seq_lens` is always False today, so this guards future configurations.
- `init_forward_metadata_out_graph` drops its unused `seq_lens_sum`, including the `seq_lens.sum().item()` sync when capturing decode CUDA graphs.
- The host-read fix this PR first carried landed in #46891 and #46897.

No behavior change, except one fewer device-to-host sync while capturing decode CUDA graphs.

raw_graphql_pull_request.title: [Fix] dsv4: Refuse the draft metadata glue when the backend needs host lengths

detail.body:
- `DeepseekV4AttnBackend.glue_draft_metadata` refuses the draft metadata glue graph when the backend needs host sequence lengths, as `glue_target_verify_metadata` already does. Under DSpark `needs_cpu_seq_lens` is always False today, so this guards future configurations.
- `init_forward_metadata_out_graph` drops its unused `seq_lens_sum`, including the `seq_lens.sum().item()` sync when capturing decode CUDA graphs.
- The host-read fix this PR first carried landed in #46891 and #46897.

No behavior change, except one fewer device-to-host sync while capturing decode CUDA graphs.

files.patch:
@@ -1403,6 +1403,7 @@ def glue_draft_metadata(self) -> str:
         # feed only asserts) except in these cases.
         for bad, why in (
             (not self.is_dspark_draft, "not the DSpark draft runner"),
+            (self.needs_cpu_seq_lens, "host sequence lengths"),
             (self.trtllm_attn, "trtllm-gen attention"),
             (self.online_c128_mtp.enabled(), "online c128 MTP"),
             (self.token_to_kv_pool.request_window is not None, "a request window"),
@@ -2677,14 +2678,12 @@ def init_forward_metadata_out_graph(
             else:
                 out_cache_loc = None
             actual_forward_mode = forward_batch.forward_mode
-            seq_lens_sum = int(seq_lens.sum().item())
             seq_lens_cpu = seq_lens.cpu() if self.needs_cpu_seq_lens else None
         else:
             out_cache_loc = forward_batch.out_cache_loc
             actual_forward_mode = getattr(
                 forward_batch, "actual_forward_mode", forward_batch.forward_mode
             )
-            seq_lens_sum = forward_batch.seq_lens_sum
             seq_lens_cpu = (
                 forward_batch.seq_lens_cpu if self.needs_cpu_seq_lens else None
             )
@@ -2699,7 +2698,6 @@ def init_forward_metadata_out_graph(
             seq_lens = torch.ones(bs, dtype=seq_lens.dtype, device=device)
             if self.needs_cpu_seq_lens:
                 seq_lens_cpu = torch.ones(bs, dtype=torch.int64)
-            seq_lens_sum = bs
             req_pool_indices = torch.zeros(
                 bs, dtype=req_pool_indices.dtype, device=device
             )
